bound: one-sided KL-Chernoff bound for iid [0,1] episode losses
multiplicity: Bonferroni across 6 scenarios for one prespecified statistical candidate
mobility_population: uniform empirical mixture of the six R73 preregistered GeoLife weeks
window_selector: first eight bytes of SHA-256('R76-window|' + decimal seed), modulo six
decision_cost_basis: design-side fee; execution settlement separately reported
selection: select g=0.75 only if every scenario upper bound is <=0.005; otherwise structural fallback g=1
test_profiles: selected policy and g=1 structural reference, deduplicated
coverage_inference: paired 10000-replicate bootstrap by episode seed within each scenario
claim_scope: conditional on the fixed six-week empirical mobility mixture and modeled economic/random response generator
